description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDependentAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Pim API namespace. The class provides RESTful API endpoints for managing employee dependents, including getting, listing, creating, updating, and deleting dependents for a particular employee, with validation rules and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee dependents, providing methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting dependents, with validation rules and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dependent for an employee based on employee number and dependent ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all dependents for a given employee, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new dependent for an employee based on provided data.

methods.name: saveEmpDependent
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate or update an EmpDependent entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for dependents' request body parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing dependent for an employee.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more dependents for an employee based on provided IDs.
